title: 2022 Panini Playoff Wave #RW-RST Rhamondre Stevenson New England Patriots Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Panini Playoff trading card features Rhamondre Stevenson of the New England Patriots. The card is a Rookie Wave parallel with the card number RW-RST. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini in the year 2022 and is part of the National Football League (NFL) league. 

The card is not autographed and has the following features: it is a great addition to any football fan's collection, it is a must-have for any fan of the New England Patriots, and it is a unique card with a wave parallel. This card is perfect for anyone who is looking for a great sports trading card to add to their collection.
